subject: Genetics
title: DNA Methylation
description: A fast breakdown of DNA Methylation for builders.

hook.text: Stick a methyl group on a gene's promoter and the gene goes silent. One tiny chemical tag shuts down an entire gene.

buildup.text: DNA methylation adds a CH₃ group to cytosine bases. Enzymes called DNMTs do the writing.

discovery.text: Methylation blocks transcription factors from binding. The gene's instructions can't be read.

climax.text: Cancer cells show abnormal methylation: tumor suppressors are silenced, oncogenes are unleashed.

punchline.text: One methyl group. Gene off. Life changed.

quiz.question: What does DNA methylation typically do to a gene?
